company.name: BlockMed Pro Global Ltd
company.description: Traditional healthcare struggles with data breaches and inefficiencies, leaving personal health information vulnerable. Imagine a future where client health records are as secure as a bank vault, yet as accessible as their social media profile, and all controlled by the client. That’s where BlockMed Pro comes in, utilising ground-breaking AI & blockchain technology to revolutionise healthcare. BlockMed Pro is a health-tech company that empowers patients to own and monetise their health records while providing pharmaceutical and research partners with secure, blockchain-backed access to anonymised, real-world clinical data. We empower end-users with control over their data, offering them the unprecedented opportunity to monetise it. Our platform gives individuals a single, unified health record they control, while transforming fragmented NHS-grade data into clean, structured, consented datasets that can be ethically used for real-world evidence, AI model training, and pharmaceutical insight generation. Every dataset is underpinned by explicit patient consent, clear provenance, and full auditability, enabling buyers to trust not just the data, but how it was sourced and governed. BlockMed Pro will immediately disrupt the $30 billion electronic health records industry by setting a new standard for data security, interoperability and patient autonomy, transforming how healthcare providers manage and secure patient information. The ultimate goal is to be a global leader in healthcare data management and AI-guided personalised care for patients.
